from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DilutedEpsRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single Diluted EPS data point extracted from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company in the document")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label used for the EPS metric in the document (e.g., '稀释每股收益')")
    eps_value: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the Diluted Earnings Per Share")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency and unit (e.g., '元/股')")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by this figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    diluted_eps_records: list[DilutedEpsRecord]
